verses.pali: yadanattā taṁ ‘netaṁ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṁ yathābhūtaṁ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṁ.
verses.english: And what’s not-self should be truly seen with right understanding like this: ‘This is not mine, I am not this, this is not my self.’

verses.pali: yadanattā taṁ ‘netaṁ mama, nesohamasmi, na meso attā’ti evametaṁ yathābhūtaṁ sammappaññāya daṭṭhabbaṁ.
verses.english: And what’s not-self should be truly seen with right understanding like this: ‘This is not mine, I am not this, this is not my self.’

verses.pali: Evaṁ passaṁ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako rūpasmimpi nibbindati, vedanāyapi … saññāyapi … saṅkhāresupi … viññāṇasmimpi nibbindati.
verses.english: Seeing this, a learned noble disciple grows disillusioned with form, feeling, perception, choices, and consciousness.

verses.pali: Nibbindaṁ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati. Vimuttasmiṁ vimuttamiti ñāṇaṁ hoti.
verses.english: Being disillusioned, desire fades away. When desire fades away they’re freed. When they’re freed, they know they’re freed.

verses.pali: ‘Khīṇā jāti, vusitaṁ brahmacariyaṁ, kataṁ karaṇīyaṁ, nāparaṁ itthattāyā’ti pajānāti.
verses.english: They understand: ‘Rebirth is ended, the spiritual journey has been completed, what had to be done has been done, there is nothing further for this place.’

verses.pali: Yāvatā, bhikkhave, sattāvāsā, yāvatā bhavaggaṁ, ete aggā, ete seṭṭhā lokasmiṁ yadidaṁ arahanto”ti.
verses.english: As far as there are abodes of sentient beings, even up until the pinnacle of existence, the perfected ones are the foremost and the best.”
That is what the Buddha said.

verses.pali: Idaṁ vatvāna sugato athāparaṁ etadavoca satthā:
verses.english: Then the Holy One, the Teacher, went on to say:
“Oh! How happy are the perfected ones!
Craving is not found in them,
the conceit ‘I am’ is cut off,
and the net of delusion is shattered.
nothing in the world clings to them,
their domain is the seven good qualities.
and trained in the three trainings,
with fear and dread given up.
those giants are immersed in samādhi.
They are the best in the world,
craving is not found in them.
‘This bag of bones is my last.’
in the core of the spiritual path.
They do not waver due to the discriminations,
They’ve reached the level of the tamed,
in the world, they’re the winners.
relishing is not found in them.
‘The awakened are supreme in the world!’”
